tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Find airport IATA codes by city, airport name, metro area, or code.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes. Returns complete booking_options with leg coverage and prices when known. Choose one link per group; multiple groups require separate bookings. booking_url is also included when one booking covers the whole itinerary.

tools.name: search_cheapest_dates
tools.description: Compare the lowest one-way or round-trip fare for each departure date across up to 31 dates. Prices are not bookable; search the chosen date with search_flights.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_flights" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes. Returns only itineraries with a preferred booking link and includes a top-level booking_url for each itinerary." → after: "Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes. Returns complete booking_options with leg coverage and prices when known. Choose one link per group; multiple groups require separate bookings. booking_url is also included when one booking covers the whole itinerary."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
